_comment: Bottom-up routing (#1949): a routed unit flees as individual men, each running from the foes he perceives toward his refuge. A brittle squadron of 24 Cavalry (blue, team 0, facing north) is staged already ROUTING (starting_state 3) with a block of 120 Infantry standing 150 wu north of it, between it and its refuge, its own rear edge to the north. Team 1's AI is off (all_teams_control), so the infantry stand still and only the rout moves. Each rider looks round once a reaction time, sees the infantry between him and his refuge, and runs away from them and round them on one side (SoldierFlightWay.choose), rather than into them or standing still where his refuge's pull and their push would balance; each rider turns away from the bulk of the riders he can see (SoldierFlightWay.own_side), so the squadron parts round both sides of the block while its centroid (its position) stays south of the infantry. On main the whole squadron fled along one fixed heading per team (north for team 0) into and through the infantry. The expects pin that the squadron is not in contact with the infantry at tick 180 (60 Hz dump basis), that at tick 240 it is still routing with its centroid within 40 wu of (800, 900), its starting point, and that at tick 240 its riders stand 745.7 wu wide (men_x_span, tol 300), against the block's 252 wu and the squadron's own 160 at tick 0: a squadron that stalled in front of the block would read no wider than the block, and this pin fails it, as it would one that ran round only one side. Measured 2026-11-20 on #1949's branch with dense 2-tick FULL dumps: not in contact at 180, on seed 0 centroid (803.33, 904.11) and span 745.7 at 240 (195.2 at tick 60, 302.9 at 120, 486.6 at 180); over seeds 0 to 4 the centroid at 240 is (802.97 to 803.33, 904.04 to 904.20) and the span 738.9 to 745.7; on main 16282049 it is in contact at 180 and at (793.3, 643.8) at 240, so both fail there. Camera ticks are in the 30 fps recording basis.
